RED scope

Path	Change
tests/paper_full_eight_square_contract_test.cpp	Adds the test-contract include and a self-test dispatch before Run(), before context/key/encryption setup.
tests/paper_endpoint_observer_contract.h	Adds test-local declarations and deterministic assertions/fixtures. All seven helper functions remain intentionally undefined.

The expected RED is missing test-local definitions at paper-target linkage, after the unchanged legacy/API checkpoint. That failure is predicted, not observed.

All 43 other supplied project files remain byte-identical, including production src/ and include/, the existing oracle, CMake, workflow, legacy tests and API fixtures. The original normal test body and completion logic are preserved.

Principal review corrections

The corrected specification resolves decimal normalization and unique-zero rules, exact comparison boundaries, Horner’s decimal-string conversion premise, serialization-error amplification during scalar replay, external hash/status semantics, and evidence finalization before propagating a finite E80 failure.

A material qualification remains explicit: the supplied Boost references are 1.83.0, whereas the historical Windows package log records 1.92.0-3. The proposed trigonometric accuracy premise is not established by those excerpts. Consequently, the numerical model is labeled CONDITIONAL, with unsupported conditions producing UNRESOLVED rather than a fabricated certificate.

The original E80 gates remain unchanged. A remains diagnostic and NOT_ADOPTED as replacement acceptance. Source-line evidence and finding IDs are in 
SPEC_REVIEW.md; the unified rules are in 
ENDPOINT_SPEC.md.

Checks actually completed

Both git apply --check and disposable patch application returned exit 0; the applied bytes match the delivered complete files. The own standard-library audit also passed integer slot-map, exact-scale, conditional rational-bound, synthetic grammar and historical primary-log checks. Source identities and 106 cited line ranges were checked.

No C++/OpenFHE configure or build, numerical codec, FFT/NTT, crypto, key generation, new chain, or CI execution was performed. No GREEN implementation was authored. The package includes the execution ledger, reproducible test plan, base/result hashes, validation script and actual output, complete changed files, patch, source map and self-excluding manifest.
